triggers.text: Still can't sleep in that apartment. Don't come over. Just text me something dumb.
triggers.note: Evelyn's death. She is grieving and wants distraction, not comfort.

triggers.text: Still have lake water in my ear. Worth it.
triggers.note: The dive, and the romance state from the save.

triggers.text: Thanks for diving with me. Means more than I said.
triggers.note: The dive, and the romance state from the save.

triggers.text: Fixed my wreath. Made it play your voice when it boots. Kidding. Unless?
triggers.note: The bond rose, and she is teasing.

triggers.text: I'm editing and it's four in the morning and I just wanted a face. Yours, specifically.
triggers.note: She is working late, and it is a soft call.

triggers.text: Grandpa asked who the person in my photos is. I said nobody. He laughed at me.
triggers.note: Her grandparents know about V now.

triggers.text: You up? Sensory track glitched and now I can't stop smelling rain.
Saw the smoke from Lizzie's. That you? Be alive, please.
triggers.note: A fight just ended in Watson, near Kabuki or Little China. She is worried.

triggers.text: Rain's good for editing. Come down to the basement, bring noodles.
triggers.note: Weather. An invitation that can become a hangout.

triggers.text: I hold the high score on this thing. Come lose to me.
triggers.note: She holds the high score on an arcade cabinet near the Kabuki roundabout and wants V to try to beat it.

triggers.text: Commercial BDs are a crime against my profession. Come watch me suffer.
triggers.note: She has rented two booths at a cheap braindance parlour in Kabuki and wants V to spot the bad cut.

triggers.text: I need ambient tracks for a BD. You're my walking microphone.
triggers.note: She wants V to walk Jig-Jig Street at night with her and stand still at spots to record sound.

triggers.text: Found my old rollerblades. They don't fit. I'm going anyway.
triggers.note: She wants V at the Laguna Bend boat ramp car park for street hockey with a can and two crates.

triggers.text: Bring me something broken. I'm in a fixing mood.
triggers.note: She is at her workbench in Lizzie's basement and wants V to bring something broken to fix.
